messages:
Maya: Quick idea — can we add a `@deploy-bot handoff` subcommand that emits an operator handoff checklist + templated release-note bullets? would save repeated copy/paste.
Ravi: yes please. we keep improvising these in threads and it's error-prone.
Jon: sketch the output so we know what to wire up?
Maya: example CLI and output:```
@deploy-bot handoff --release 2026.03.12 --service api-server --canary 5% --pin v1.4.2
---
- Release: 2026.03.12 v1.4.2
- Service: api-server
- Canary: 5% (3 pods)
- Health checks: /health, p95 < 150ms
- Rollback trigger: error rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR latency p95 > 400ms
- Rollback command: /deploy rollback --to v1.4.1
- Migration/DB notes: run migrate job `jobs/migrate-feature-x` after canary OK
- Escalation: on-call @oncall-team, if rollback occurs escalate to @Ravi
- Post-release tasks: post-merge-tag, update docs, notify #product
```
Jon: nice. also add a separate `@deploy-bot notes --template short` that outputs 2–3 bullet release notes suitable for product digest.
Kelly: RBAC concern — restrict `handoff` to release-ops + release-captains and audit all runs. we need an audit link emitted.
Maya: good point. also add a `--dry-run` flag to preview without touching pins or notes. and `--summary "one-line digest"` to auto-fill product message.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Generated handoff checklist for release 2026.03.12 by Maya. Preview: https://deploy.internal/release/2026.03.12/preview
Ravi: can we include an autogenerated health-check snippet based on service metrics (e.g., p50/p95 windows)? if not, keep placeholder.
Jon: implementation note — templates live in repo at `infra/deploy/templates/handoff.md.j2`, the command just renders and posts to thread + an internal release object. small service.
Kelly: I'll own the PR. will add unit tests for template rendering and permission checks. aiming EOW for PR branch and staging deploy next Tue.
Maya: add `@deploy-bot annotate --commit abc123 --notes "regen kv cache"` to attach freeform notes to the release object. useful for followups.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Permission matrix updated: allowed groups = release-ops, release-captains, deploy-admins. Audit event cv: https://audit.internal/events/ae-7890
Ravi: please ensure the output includes explicit rollback command and a short checklist for verification steps (smoke endpoints, quick k6 script, dashboard links).
Jon: add escape hatch snippet to README:```
# rollback to previous
/deploy rollback --to v1.4.1 --reason "metric spike" --force
```
Kelly: will include that in the PR. also adding a one-click escalate link for oncall.
Maya: :thumbsup: can we also let handoff include `--pin` semantics: if `--pin auto` then bot opens a PR to pin image tag; `--pin confirm` prompts for manual approve.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Created issue #452: "handoff subcommand + templates" assigned to Kelly. ETA milestone: 2026-03-24.
Ravi: sweet. thanks everyone. i'll prep the canary run checklist for staging and ping #eng-sre when PR is ready.
Kelly: will ping here when PR is up.
Maya: thanks all — this should cut 5–10m per release and reduce mistakes.
